output.source_text: Scale selection for AmMaj7 (A C E G#): 1. A Melodic Minor (A B C D E F# G#) has 0 avoid notes; 2. A Harmonic Minor (A B C D E F G#) has 1 avoid note (F); 3. A Double Harmonic Minor (A Bb C D# E F G#) has avoid notes (F, Bb). In practice, jazz musicians prefer Melodic Minor.
